messages.content: The crash is in `QuietHours`, but the bad value comes from `updatePrefs`: `clockPattern` accepts `24:00` through `99:59`, so hour 24 gets stored and later indexes `quiet[24]`. Let me check the existing API tests before writing a reproducer.
The reproducer will check that `PUT /v1/me/prefs` rejects out-of-range clock times. On the current code it returns 200, so it fails.
